theorem lemma_4_2_4 {α x δ Q₀ U V : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx2 α x δ a q Q₀)
    (hQ₀ : 2 * rexp 1 ≤ Q₀) (hx : 10 ≤ x) (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hD2 : 2 ≤ U * V) :
    ((|δ| ≤ 1 / (2 * c₂) ∨ U * V ≤ Q₀ / 2) →
      ‖typeI2 α x U V‖ ≤ bound_4_50 x δ q U V + bound_4_51 x q U V) ∧
    (1 / (2 * c₂) ≤ |δ| → ∀ ε, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 →
      ‖typeI2 α x U V‖ ≤ bound_4_50 x δ q U V + bound_4_52 x δ q U V Q₀ ε) :=

note: Lean's form uses c₁ = 1+|η'|₁/(x/D) (book prints 2x/D), block upper-end weights, log⁺(q/2), and a √x term about 1.6 times the book's; it needs x ≥ 10, UV ≥ 2 and drops UV + (19/18)Q₀ ≤ x/5.6. Erratum: The book's remark that (4.51) also holds for R = q/2 fails: the j=0 term of (4.62) gives sqrt3 q log(q/2), and the book's own chain exceeds the printed (4.51) at x=1e12, q=Q_0=D=1e10 (ratio 1.0415) and at x=1e20, q=D=1e17 (ratio 1.0264) (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_4_51.py`).
